mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and seizures which may be potentiated by rasagiline's CNS effects; additionally, foscarnet's nephrotoxicity may affect rasagiline clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and neurological status closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider dose adjustment if renal impairment develops.
